name: multistore-review-platform
description: MultiStore - multi-vendor store & customer review platform (Express + Prisma + SQLite/PostgreSQL, React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
